## Codebase Structure Pattern

### Pattern A: Data File Pattern (for smaller tutorials)
```
SubjectTheory/
├── SubjectTutorial.tsx   (Main layout component)
├── MainContent.tsx       (Content renderer)
├── Sidebar.tsx           (Navigation sidebar)
└── SubjectData.tsx       (All topics data in one file)
```

### Pattern B: Topic Folder Pattern (for larger tutorials)
```
Subject/
├── Subject.tsx           (Main layout component)
├── SubjectSidebar.tsx    (Navigation sidebar)
├── Layout.tsx            (Layout wrapper)
├── SidebarData.ts        (Navigation data)
└── Topic/
    ├── Home.tsx
    ├── Intro.tsx
    ├── GetStarted.tsx
    ├── TopicCategory1/
    │   ├── Subtopic1.tsx
    │   └── Subtopic2.tsx
    └── TopicCategory2/
        ├── Subtopic1.tsx
        └── Subtopic2.tsx
```
